codes.message: Credentials were rejected by the server.
codes.suggestion: Verify the token and its roles, then retry with corrected credentials.

codes.message: The authenticated principal lacks permission for this action.
codes.suggestion: Grant the required role or use a principal that holds it.

codes.message: The requested object does not exist.
codes.suggestion: Check the identifier; remember the object first if this is a write-before-read.

codes.message: An argument is malformed or out of range.
codes.suggestion: Fix the argument; the server will reject it unchanged.
Use compile/explain to see the compiler error.

codes.message: The operation conflicts with current state (constraint or version).
codes.suggestion: Re-read the object and re-apply against the current version.

codes.message: Server version is older than the SDK minimum.
codes.suggestion: Upgrade the server, or pin an older SDK.
Retry with backoff; consider a longer deadline.

codes.message: The operation was cancelled by the caller.
codes.suggestion: Re-issue only if the cancelled work is known not to have committed.

codes.message: A server limit was reached (pool, memory, concurrency).
codes.suggestion: Retry with backoff; reduce concurrency or batch size.

codes.message: The server is unreachable or not ready.
codes.suggestion: Retry with backoff; verify the transport and server health.

codes.message: The server hit an internal error.
codes.suggestion: Report with the request_id; the outcome is unknown.

codes.message: The peer violated the protocol (framing, correlation, type).
codes.suggestion: Check SDK/server version pairing; never retried blindly.
Restore from backup; surface the affected object.
